title: Direct stimulus bias
summary: The player overvalues scenarios that look like the game on the surface, even when they do not train the right response pattern for the goal.
telltales: Scenarios are chosen because they are tagged with the main game rather than because they train the needed movement
The player equates visual similarity with transfer quality
contraindications: Do not overcorrect into choosing abstract tasks with no transfer logic at all
avoid: Assuming one-to-one stimulus matching is always the best training choice
